subject: Three‑party kickoff: champion + engineering lead + procurement readiness
messages:
From: Leah Porter <leah.porter@ardentsys.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro + request to schedule discovery

Hi Jonas —

Thanks for the intro earlier. We (Ardent Systems) are excited to move ahead with an initial discovery so we can validate fit and scope. I wanted to loop in my engineering lead and procurement. High level: we need a 45–60 min session that covers architecture fit, data flow constraints, and procurement/timeline expectations.

Proposed attendees from our side: Marcus Hale (Eng Lead) and Ellen Chu (Procurement). Can you include an SE and anyone from your side who owns the procurement checklist / pricing guardrails?

Our rough availability next week (PDT): Tue 8/17 after 11am, Thu 8/19 1–4pm, Fri 8/20 mornings only. If those don’t work, send two or three alternatives and we’ll narrow. Also, can you share any pre-read or checklist so our procurement team can prep?

Thanks — Leah
Leah Porter
Head of Product, Ardent Systems
leah.porter@ardentsys.com

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Leah Porter <leah.porter@ardentsys.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2026 09:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + request to schedule discovery

Hi Leah — thanks for the clear list. Happy to run the kickoff.

Sooj and I will join from product/SE and Marissa (cc’d) will help coordinate procurement/contract questions. I’ve attached a short procurement checklist we typically send ahead (see attachment stub).

Proposed slots (PDT):
- Tue 8/17 12:30–1:15pm
- Thu 8/19 1:30–2:15pm
- Fri 8/20 9:00–9:45am

Please confirm which of the above works for Marcus and Ellen, or tell us two other times and we’ll lock one. Agenda (45 min):
1) 10m intros & success criteria (Leah / Ardent)
2) 15m architecture and data flow (Marcus + Soojin)
3) 10m procurement/timeline & required artifacts (Ellen + Marissa)
4) 10m open Qs / next steps (mutual action plan)

Attachments: procurement-checklist.pdf (stub)

Jonas Weber
Senior AE, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai

From: Marcus Hale <marcus.hale@ardentsys.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Leah Porter <leah.porter@ardentsys.com>
Cc: Ellen Chu <ellen.chu@ardentsys.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2026 10:24:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + request to schedule discovery

Thanks Jonas — appreciate the checklist. Quick notes from the eng side:
- We prefer afternoon windows (PDT) but Thurs 8/19 is tight for our infra team.
- Tues 8/17 at 12:30 would work but I’d prefer 1–1:45pm to avoid a calendar collision.
- We’ll want to cover the following: token retention & deletion options, VPC/on‑prem deployment path, and any pre-approved quantization/latency profiles you support.

Ellen (procurement) — can you confirm if you need a vendor packet or priority SOW template before the call?

–Marcus
Marcus Hale
Engineering Lead, Ardent Systems
marcus.hale@ardentsys.com

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Hale <marcus.hale@ardentsys.com>, Leah Porter <leah.porter@ardentsys.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2026 11:06:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + request to schedule discovery

Perfect — thanks Marcus. Let’s lock Thu 8/19 at 1:30–2:15pm PDT since that fits Ardent and keeps it in the afternoon block you prefer (Marcus).

I’ll send a calendar invite with a short mutual action plan attached and a meeting link. Agenda will include the three engineering topics you listed plus procurement next steps.

Meeting details (provisional):
- When: Thu, 19 Aug 2026, 1:30–2:15pm PDT
- Where: Zoom (link in invite)
- Attendees: Leah Porter (Champion), Marcus Hale (Eng Lead), Ellen Chu (Procurement), Jonas Weber (AE), Soojin Lee (SE), Marissa Cole (Sales Ops)

Attachments included: mutual-action-plan.docx (stub)
Pre-read: procurement-checklist.pdf (sent earlier)
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/AR-9876

If procurement needs anything earlier (vendor packet, audited SOC documentation, or a price band for planning), Marissa can pick that up — Marissa, could you confirm what you can share before the call?

Thanks — Jonas

From: Leah Porter <leah.porter@ardentsys.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Hale <marcus.hale@ardentsys.com>, Ellen Chu <ellen.chu@ardentsys.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2026 11:38:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + request to schedule discovery

Thanks — Thu 1:30–2:15 works for all of us. Confirmed. Ellen says a vendor packet would be helpful but not required in advance; the procurement checklist is a great start. Looking forward to the agenda and MAP.

See you then — Leah
